banner: SYNTHETIC DATA - NOT REAL PHARMACY DATA.
Proposed weights (D 0.35, R 0.30, C 0.20, I 0.15) and tier thresholds (80 / 60 / 40) are research parameters, not NMRA-prescribed values.
These results show computational correctness and robustness to weight assumptions only. They do not show real-world accuracy.

functional.title: Delivery reliability: 7 on-time of 10 eligible -> D = 70
Recall response: 9 of 12 applicable recall actions -> R = 75
Complaint handling: 4 of 6 eligible complaints -> C = 66.666...
No eligible recall records -> R NOT_ASSESSABLE; overall NOT_ASSESSABLE, score null, no renormalisation
Duplicate evidence submitted twice -> counted once; numerator and denominator unchanged
Critical finding with high score (>= 80) -> escalation required, score unchanged
Supplementary: indicator value 0 is ASSESSABLE and distinct from NOT_ASSESSABLE

checks.description: Missing indicator -> NOT_ASSESSABLE, score null, no renormalisation
Critical finding -> escalation required regardless of score; score unchanged
No critical finding -> escalation not required
Boundary profiles (80/60/40) -> exact score and tier
Zero-value indicator is ASSESSABLE and distinct from NOT_ASSESSABLE
All evidence SYNTHETIC; assessable scores labelled SYNTHETIC
Determinism: same seed -> identical results; different seed -> different profiles

sensitivity.note: Renormalisation is used here only for weight perturbation; the production rule never renormalises for missing indicators (missing indicator -> NOT_ASSESSABLE).

global.distribution: Dirichlet(1,1,1,1): uniform over all weight vectors summing to 1
